tasks.title: Define the todo data model
tasks.description: Create a TypeScript type for a todo item with id, text, done and createdAt fields.
acceptanceCriteria: A Todo type is exported from src/todo.ts
Unit tests cover construction of a todo

tasks.title: Persist todos to a JSON file
tasks.description: Implement load and save functions for the todo list using a JSON file in the working directory.
acceptanceCriteria: Saving then loading returns the same todos
A missing file loads as an empty list

tasks.title: Add the command-line interface
tasks.description: Provide add, list and done commands that use the persistence layer.
acceptanceCriteria: todo done <id> marks an item complete
